coinpaprika.jurisdiction_status: No explicit country exclusion was found in the API documentation reviewed; personal-use restriction applies and applicable-law compliance remains required.

coinranking.jurisdiction_status: No explicit Iran exclusion found in the published API terms reviewed; account eligibility is not independently confirmed until Coinranking accepts registration and issues the key. Applicable-law compliance remains the account holder's responsibility.
coinranking.free_plan_positioning: Pricing page labels Free as ideal for testing; API terms permit internal analysis and internal application development. No SLA; 5,000 calls/month; 5 requests/second; 100 results/request; 1-year price history.

coingecko.reason: Published excluded-country list includes Iran; network reachability is not authorization.

coincap.reason: Free plan is described as demo/testing and requires API key; not selected for production.

coinlore.reason: Terms and automated-use permissions not sufficiently verified.

operational_rule: Production acceptance requires at least two independent, fresh, license-eligible providers with exact identity matches for all nine candidate assets. Any pair among CoinMarketCap Free Basic, Coinranking Free, and CoinPaprika Personal may qualify. Keyless CMC and CoinGecko do not count.
